documents.title: Eval: Ingestion Pipeline
documents.content: Ask Selectiva ingests knowledge by accepting webhook or upload input, queueing a document in Kafka, then a consumer fetches content, chunks text, creates local sentence-transformer embeddings, and stores chunks in PostgreSQL with pgvector.
